ROOT.scriptdef: IF EXISTS (SELECT * FROM dbo.sysobjects WHERE id = OBJECT_ID(N'CDN.ESKLEP_EksportKnt') AND OBJECTPROPERTY(id, N'IsProcedure') = 1) DROP PROCEDURE CDN.ESKLEP_EksportKnt

CREATE PROCEDURE CDN.ESKLEP_EksportKnt @ID INT -- ID e-sklepu ,@TypExp INT -- Typ eksportu cennika (0 - różnicowy, 1 - pełny)
AS SET NOCOUNT ON DECLARE @AktualnaData INT = DATEDIFF(D,CONVERT(DATETIME,'1800-12-28',120),GETDATE()) DECLARE @TypOsoba INT = 8211
CREATE TABLE #tmpRecordSet( /* Kontrahenci */ GIDNumer INT, Nazwa1 nVARCHAR(50) COLLATE Polish_CI_AS, Nazwa2 nVARCHAR(50) COLLATE Polish_CI_AS, Nazwa3 nVARCHAR(250) COLLATE Polish_CI_AS, Miasto nVARCHAR(50) COLLATE Polish_CI_AS, KodP nVARCHAR(20) COLLATE Polish_CI_AS, Ulica nVARCHAR(50) COLLATE Polish_CI_AS, NrBudynek nVARCHAR(50) COLLATE Polish_CI_AS, NrLokal nVARCHAR(50) COLLATE Polish_CI_AS, Wojewodztwo nVARCHAR(50), NIP nVARCHAR(20) COLLATE Polish_CI_AS /* Kontrahenci */ , Kraj VARCHAR(2) COLLATE Polish_CI_AS, Email nVARCHAR(192) COLLATE Polish_CI_AS, Telefon nVARCHAR(50) COLLATE Polish_CI_AS/* ,DataUrodzenia SMALLDATETIME */, Waluta VARCHAR(3) COLLATE Polish_CI_AS, Typ SMALLINT, TypTransakcji SMALLINT, Pesel VARCHAR(20) COLLATE Polish_CI_AS,SklepID INT, LimitK TINYINT,LimitPP TINYINT /* Adresy */ ,AdresID INT, AdresNazwa1 nVARCHAR(50) COLLATE Polish_CI_AS, AdresNazwa2 nVARCHAR(50) COLLATE Polish_CI_AS, AdresNazwa3 nVARCHAR(250) COLLATE Polish_CI_AS, AdresMiasto nVARCHAR(50) COLLATE Polish_CI_AS, AdresKodP nVARCHAR(20) COLLATE Polish_CI_AS /* Adresy */ , AdresUlica nVARCHAR(50) COLLATE Polish_CI_AS, AdresNrBudynek nVARCHAR(20) COLLATE Polish_CI_AS, AdresNrLokal nVARCHAR(20) COLLATE Polish_CI_AS, AdresWojewodztwo nVARCHAR(50) COLLATE Polish_CI_AS, AdresKraj VARCHAR(2) COLLATE Polish_CI_AS, AdresTelefon nVARCHAR(50) COLLATE Polish_CI_AS, AdresDomyslny SMALLINT, Cena INT /*Osoby*/,KnSSyncID INT,KnSImie NVARCHAR(50),KnSNazwisko NVARCHAR(50),KnSTelefon NVARCHAR(50),KnSEmail NVARCHAR(192),KNSAdmin SMALLINT,KnSJezyk INT, ZgoID INT,ZgoDataWycofania INT,VerID VARCHAR(36),ID VARCHAR(36),ZgdIP VARCHAR(16) )
INSERT INTO #tmpRecordSet SELECT Knt_GIDNumer, CDN.XLValidateXMLChars(Knt_Nazwa1), CDN.XLValidateXMLChars(Knt_Nazwa2), CDN.XLValidateXMLChars(Knt_Nazwa3), CDN.XLValidateXMLChars(Knt_Miasto), Knt_KodP, CDN.XLValidateXMLChars(CDN.ParsujAdres(Knt_Ulica,1)), CASE WHEN CDN.ParsujAdres(Knt_Ulica,2)='' THEN CDN.ParsujAdresNrDomu(Knt_Adres,1) ELSE CDN.ParsujAdres(Knt_Ulica,2) END , CASE WHEN CDN.ParsujAdres(Knt_Ulica,3)='' THEN CDN.ParsujAdresNrDomu(Knt_Adres,2) ELSE CDN.ParsujAdres(Knt_Ulica,3) END, Knt_Wojewodztwo, Knt_Nip , CDN.KodKrajuIntrastatNaISO(Knt_Kraj), Knt_EMail, Knt_Telefon1 /*,'24-10-1977'*/, Knt_Symbol, case when Knt_Status=1 then 1 else 0 end, case when Knt_ExpoKraj=1 then 1 when Knt_ExpoKraj=2 then 2 else 3 end , Knt_Pesel,PCLKnt.PcL_ObiektID, CASE WHEN ISNULL(KLK_MaxLimitWart,-1) >=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS LimitK, CASE WHEN ISNULL(KLK_LimitPoTerminie,-1) BETWEEN 0 AND 99.99 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS LimitPP , KnA_GIDNumer, CDN.XLValidateXMLChars(KnA_Nazwa1), CDN.XLValidateXMLChars(KnA_Nazwa2), CDN.XLValidateXMLChars(KnA_Nazwa3), CDN.XLValidateXMLChars(KnA_Miasto), KnA_KodP , CDN.ParsujAdres(KnA_Ulica,1), left(CASE WHEN CDN.ParsujAdres(KnA_Ulica,2)='' THEN CDN.ParsujAdresNrDomu(KnA_Adres,1) ELSE CDN.ParsujAdres(KnA_Ulica,2) END,20), left(CASE WHEN CDN.ParsujAdres(KnA_Ulica,3)='' THEN CDN.ParsujAdresNrDomu(KnA_Adres,2) ELSE CDN.ParsujAdres(KnA_Ulica,3) END,20), KnA_Wojewodztwo, CDN.KodKrajuIntrastatNaISO(KnA_Kraj), KnA_Telefon1 , case when exists(select KnA_Domyslny from cdn.KntAdresy where KnA_KntNumer = Knt_GIDNumer and KnA_Domyslny=1) then KnA_Domyslny when KnA_GIDTyp = 864 then 1 else 0 end , case when FRAKnt.FrA_CenaDomyslna = 0 then NULL else FRAKnt.FrA_CenaDomyslna end ,CASE WHEN FRAOsoby.FrA_ObiNumer IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE KnS_SyncID END,SUBSTRING(KnS_Nazwa,1,CHARINDEX(' ',KnS_Nazwa,1)) AS KnSImie,SUBSTRING(KnS_Nazwa,CHARINDEX(' ',KnS_Nazwa,1)+1,LEN(KnS_Nazwa)) AS KnSNazwisko,CASE WHEN LEN(KnS_Telefon)>1 THEN KnS_Telefon ELSE KnS_TelefonK END,KnS_EMail,FRAOsoby.FrA_Admin,CASE WHEN ISNULL(SlwJezyk.SLW_Predefiniowany,0) IN (21,22,23,24,25,34,35,36,98,99,100,101,110) THEN SlwJezyk.SLW_WartoscL3 ELSE 1 END, Zgo_ID,Zgo_DataWycofania,PCLZgody.PCL_ObiektGUID AS VerID,PCLZgodyPodstawowa.PCL_ObiektGUID AS ID,Zgo_IP AS ZgdIP FROM CDN.KntKarty JOIN CDN.KntAdresy on KnA_KntNumer = Knt_GIDNumer JOIN CDN.PicoKonfig ON Pck_PicoId = @ID JOIN CDN.FrsAplikacje FRAKnt ON FrA_ObiNumer = Knt_GIDNumer AND FrA_ObiTyp = 32 AND FrA_TypAplikacji = 2 AND FrA_NieWysylaj = 0 AND (FrA_FrsID = 0 OR FrA_FrsId = PcK_CentrumID) LEFT JOIN CDN.KntOsoby ON KnS_KntNumer = Knt_GIDNumer AND KnS_Archiwalny = 0 LEFT OUTER JOIN CDN.PicoLog PCLKnt ON PCLKnt.PcL_PcKID = Pck_PicoId AND PCLKnt.PcL_ObiTyp = Knt_GIDTyp AND PCLKnt.PcL_ObiNumer = Knt_GIDNumer LEFT OUTER JOIN CDN.PicoLog PCLOsoby ON PCLOsoby.PcL_PcKID = Pck_PicoId AND PCLOsoby.PcL_ObiTyp = @TypOsoba AND PCLOsoby.PcL_ObiNumer = KnS_SyncID LEFT JOIN CDN.Zgody ON Zgo_ObiTyp = @TypOsoba AND ZgO_ObiNumer = KnS_KntNumer AND Zgo_ObiLp = KnS_KntLp AND Zgo_CzasModyfikacji > ISNULL(PCLOsoby.PcL_TStamp,0) LEFT OUTER JOIN CDN.PicoLog PCLZgody ON PCLZgody.PcL_PcKID = Pck_PicoId AND PCLZgody.PcL_ObiTyp = -6560 AND PCLZgody.PcL_ObiNumer = Zgo_RodzajZgody LEFT OUTER JOIN CDN.Slowniki SlwZgodaWersja ON SlwZgodaWersja.SLW_ID = PCLZgody.PcL_ObiNumer LEFT OUTER JOIN CDN.Slowniki SlwJezyk ON SlwJezyk.SLW_ID = KnS_PreferowanyJezyk AND SlwJezyk.SLW_WartoscL2 IN (2,3) -- parametr isklep24 LEFT OUTER JOIN CDN.PicoLog PCLZgodyPodstawowa ON PCLZgodyPodstawowa.PcL_PcKID = Pck_PicoId AND PCLZgodyPodstawowa.PcL_ObiTyp = -6560 AND PCLZgodyPodstawowa.PcL_ObiNumer = SlwZgodaWersja.SLW_WersjaZrodlo LEFT JOIN CDN.FrsAplikacje FRAOsoby ON FRAOsoby.FrA_ObiNumer = KnS_SyncID AND FRAOsoby.FrA_ObiTyp = @TypOsoba AND FRAOsoby.FrA_TypAplikacji = 2 AND FRAOsoby.FrA_NieWysylaj = 0 AND (FRAOsoby.FrA_FrsID = 0 OR FRAOsoby.FrA_FrsId = PcK_CentrumID) AND (KnS_CzasModyfikacji > CASE WHEN @TypExp=0 THEN PcK_TSSynchrKnt ELSE 0 END OR ISNULL(PCLOsoby.PcL_TStamp,0) < KnS_CzasModyfikacji) LEFT OUTER JOIN CDN.KntLimityK ON KLK_KntNumer = Knt_GIDNumer AND KLK_KntTyp = Knt_GIDTyp AND KlK_DataOd <= @AktualnaData AND KLK_DataDo >= @AktualnaData WHERE ((KnA_GIDTyp = 864 and KnA_DataArc=0) OR KnA_GIDTyp = 896 and KnA_Wysylkowy=1 and KnA_DataArc=0) AND (Knt_LastModL > CASE WHEN @TypExp=0 THEN PcK_TSSynchrKnt ELSE 0 END OR ISNULL(PCLKnt.PcL_TStamp,0) < Knt_LastModL OR (FRAOsoby.FrA_ObiNumer IS NOT NULL))
SELECT DISTINCT 1 AS Tag, NULL AS Parent /* kontrahenci <KNT> */ , GIDNumer AS [KNT!1!GIDNumer], Nazwa1 AS [KNT!1!Nazwa1], Nazwa2 AS [KNT!1!Nazwa2], Nazwa3 AS [KNT!1!Nazwa3], Miasto AS [KNT!1!Miasto], KodP AS [KNT!1!KodP], Ulica AS [KNT!1!Ulica], NrBudynek AS [KNT!1!NrBudynek], NrLokal AS [KNT!1!NrLokal], Wojewodztwo AS [KNT!1!Wojewodztwo], NIP AS [KNT!1!NIP] , Kraj AS [KNT!1!Kraj], Email AS [KNT!1!Email], Telefon AS [KNT!1!Telefon], Waluta AS [KNT!1!Waluta], Typ AS [KNT!1!Typ],TypTransakcji AS [KNT!1!TypTransakcji], Pesel AS [KNT!1!Pesel], Cena AS [KNT!1!CenaID],SklepID AS [KNT!1!SklepID], LimitK AS [KNT!1!LimitK], LimitPP AS [KNT!1!LimitPP] ,NULL AS [KNTA!2] , NULL AS [KNA!3!GIDNumer], NULL AS [KNA!3!AdresID], NULL AS [KNA!3!Nazwa1], NULL AS [KNA!3!Nazwa2],NULL AS [KNA!3!Nazwa3], NULL AS [KNA!3!Miasto], NULL AS [KNA!3!KodP] , NULL AS [KNA!3!Ulica], NULL AS [KNA!3!NrBudynek], NULL AS [KNA!3!NrLokal], NULL AS [KNA!3!Wojewodztwo], NULL AS [KNA!3!Kraj], NULL AS [KNA!3!Telefon], NULL AS [KNA!3!Domyslny] ,NULL AS [KNTP!4] ,NULL AS [KNP!5!GIDNumer],NULL AS [KNP!5!PID],NULL AS [KNP!5!Imie],NULL AS [KNP!5!Nazwisko],NULL AS [KNP!5!Telefon],NULL AS [KNP!5!Email],NULL AS [KNP!5!Admin],NULL AS [KNP!5!JezykID] ,NULL AS [ZGDI!6] ,NULL AS [ZGD!7!ID],NULL AS [ZGD!7!VerID],NULL AS [ZGD!7!Stan],NULL AS [ZGD!7!JezykID],NULL AS [ZGD!7!Data],NULL AS [ZGD!7!IP] FROM #tmpRecordSet UNION ALL SELECT DISTINCT 2 AS Tag, 1 AS Parent /* Ceny <KNTA> */ , GIDNumer, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL , NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL,NULL, NULL AS [KNT!1!LimitK], NULL AS [KNT!1!LimitPP] ,NULL ,NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL ,NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL, NULL,NULL ,NULL ,NULL AS [KNP!5!GIDNumer],NULL AS [KNP!5!PID],NULL AS [KNP!5!Imie],NULL AS [KNP!5!Nazwisko],NULL AS [KNP!5!Telefon],NULL AS [KNP!5!Email],NULL AS [KNP!5!Admin],NULL AS [KNP!5!JezykID] ,NULL AS [ZGDI!6] ,NULL AS [ZGD!7!ID],NULL AS [ZGD!7!VerID],NULL AS [ZGD!7!Stan],NULL AS [ZGD!7!JezykID],NULL AS [ZGD!7!Data],NULL AS [ZGD!7!IP]
FROM #tmpRecordSet UNION ALL SELECT DISTINCT 3 AS Tag, 2 AS Parent /* Ceny <KNA> polski */ , GIDNumer, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL , NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL,NULL, NULL AS [KNT!1!LimitK], NULL AS [KNT!1!LimitPP] ,NULL , GIDNumer, AdresID, AdresNazwa1, AdresNazwa2, AdresNazwa3, AdresMiasto, AdresKodP , AdresUlica, AdresNrBudynek,AdresNrLokal, AdresWojewodztwo, AdresKraj, AdresTelefon, AdresDomyslny ,NULL ,NULL AS [KNP!5!GIDNumer],NULL AS [KNP!5!PID],NULL AS [KNP!5!Imie],NULL AS [KNP!5!Nazwisko],NULL AS [KNP!5!Telefon],NULL AS [KNP!5!Email],NULL AS [KNP!5!Admin],NULL AS [KNP!5!JezykID] ,NULL AS [ZGDI!6] ,NULL AS [ZGD!7!ID],NULL AS [ZGD!7!VerID],NULL AS [ZGD!7!Stan],NULL AS [ZGD!7!JezykID],NULL AS [ZGD!7!Data],NULL AS [ZGD!7!IP]
FROM #tmpRecordSet UNION ALL SELECT DISTINCT 4 AS Tag, 1 AS Parent /* Osoby <KNTP> */ , GIDNumer, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL , NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL,NULL, NULL AS [KNT!1!LimitK], NULL AS [KNT!1!LimitPP] ,NULL ,NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL ,NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL, NULL,NULL ,NULL ,NULL AS [KNP!5!GIDNumer],NULL AS [KNP!5!PID],NULL AS [KNP!5!Imie],NULL AS [KNP!5!Nazwisko],NULL AS [KNP!5!Telefon],NULL AS [KNP!5!Email],NULL AS [KNP!5!Admin],NULL AS [KNP!5!JezykID] ,NULL AS [ZGDI!6] ,NULL AS [ZGD!7!ID],NULL AS [ZGD!7!VerID],NULL AS [ZGD!7!Stan],NULL AS [ZGD!7!JezykID],NULL AS [ZGD!7!Data],NULL AS [ZGD!7!IP]
FROM #tmpRecordSet WHERE KnSSyncID IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT DISTINCT 5 AS Tag, 4 AS Parent /* Osoby <KNTP> */ , GIDNumer, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL , NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL,NULL, NULL AS [KNT!1!LimitK], NULL AS [KNT!1!LimitPP] ,NULL ,NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL ,NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL, NULL,NULL ,NULL ,GIDNumer AS [KNP!5!GIDNumer],KnSSyncID AS [KNP!5!PID],(CASE WHEN LEN(KnSImie) > 0 THEN KnSImie ELSE KnSNazwisko END) AS [KNP!5!Imie],KnSNazwisko AS [KNP!5!Nazwisko],KnSTelefon AS [KNP!5!Telefon],KnSEmail AS [KNP!5!Email],KNSAdmin AS [KNP!5!Admin],KnSJezyk AS [KNP!5!JezykID] ,NULL AS [ZGDI!6] ,NULL AS [ZGD!7!ID],NULL AS [ZGD!7!VerID],NULL AS [ZGD!7!Stan],NULL AS [ZGD!7!JezykID],NULL AS [ZGD!7!Data],NULL AS [ZGD!7!IP]
FROM #tmpRecordSet WHERE KnSSyncID IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT DISTINCT 6 AS Tag, 5 AS Parent /* Zgody osoby <ZGDI> */ , GIDNumer, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL , NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL,NULL, NULL AS [KNT!1!LimitK], NULL AS [KNT!1!LimitPP] ,NULL ,NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL ,NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL, NULL,NULL ,NULL ,NULL AS [KNP!5!GIDNumer],NULL AS [KNP!5!PID],NULL AS [KNP!5!Imie],NULL AS [KNP!5!Nazwisko],NULL AS [KNP!5!Telefon],NULL AS [KNP!5!Email],NULL AS [KNP!5!Admin],NULL AS [KNP!5!JezykID] ,NULL AS [ZGDI!6] ,ID AS [ZGD!7!ID],VerID AS [ZGD!7!VerID],NULL AS [ZGD!7!Stan],NULL AS [ZGD!7!JezykID],DATEADD(day,ZgoDataWycofania,CONVERT(DATETIME,'1800-12-28',120)) AS [ZGD!7!Data],ZgdIP AS [ZGD!7!IP]
FROM #tmpRecordSet WHERE KnSSyncID IS NOT NULL AND VerID IS NOT NULL AND ZgoDataWycofania > 0 UNION ALL SELECT DISTINCT 7 AS Tag, 6 AS Parent /* Zgody osoby <ZGD> */ , GIDNumer, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL , NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL,NULL, NULL AS [KNT!1!LimitK], NULL AS [KNT!1!LimitPP] ,NULL ,NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL ,NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL, NULL,NULL ,NULL ,GIDNumer AS [KNP!5!GIDNumer],KnSSyncID AS [KNP!5!PID],(CASE WHEN LEN(KnSImie) > 0 THEN KnSImie ELSE KnSNazwisko END) AS [KNP!5!Imie],KnSNazwisko AS [KNP!5!Nazwisko],KnSTelefon AS [KNP!5!Telefon],KnSEmail AS [KNP!5!Email],KNSAdmin AS [KNP!5!Admin],KnSJezyk AS [KNP!5!JezykID] ,NULL AS [ZGDI!6] ,ID AS [ZGD!7!ID],VerID AS [ZGD!7!VerID],0 AS [ZGD!7!Stan],1 AS [ZGD!7!JezykID],DATEADD(day,ZgoDataWycofania,CONVERT(DATETIME,'1800-12-28',120)) AS [ZGD!7!Data],ZgdIP AS [ZGD!7!IP]
FROM #tmpRecordSet WHERE KnSSyncID IS NOT NULL AND VerID IS NOT NULL AND ZgoDataWycofania > 0 ORDER BY [KNT!1!GIDNumer], Tag FOR XML EXPLICIT, BINARY BASE64
INSERT INTO CDN.PicoLog (PcL_PcKID, PcL_ObiTyp, PcL_ObiNumer, PcL_ObiektID, PcL_Komentarz, PcL_Info, PcL_TStamp) SELECT DISTINCT @ID, 32, Knt_GIDNumer, -1, 'Kontrahent - '+ Knt_Akronim, '', DATEDIFF(s,CONVERT(DATETIME,'19900101',121),GETDATE()) FROM CDN.KntKarty JOIN #tmpRecordSet ON Knt_GIDNumer = GIDNumer LEFT OUTER JOIN CDN.PicoLog ON PcL_PcKID = @ID AND PcL_ObiTyp = Knt_GIDTyp AND PcL_ObiNumer = Knt_GIDNumer WHERE PcL_ID IS NULL
INSERT INTO CDN.PicoLog (PcL_PcKID, PcL_ObiTyp, PcL_ObiNumer, PcL_ObiektID, PcL_Komentarz, PcL_Info, PcL_TStamp) SELECT DISTINCT @ID, 8211, KnSSyncID, -1, 'Osoba - '+ KnS_Nazwa, '', DATEDIFF(s,CONVERT(DATETIME,'19900101',121),GETDATE()) FROM CDN.KntOsoby JOIN #tmpRecordSet ON KnSSyncID = KnS_SyncID AND KnSSyncID IS NOT NULL LEFT OUTER JOIN CDN.PicoLog ON PcL_PcKID = @ID AND PcL_ObiTyp = 8211 AND PcL_ObiNumer = KnS_SyncID WHERE PcL_ID IS NULL
DROP TABLE #tmpRecordSet SET NOCOUNT OFF
GRANT EXECUTE ON CDN.ESKLEP_EksportKnt TO CDNRaport
